messages.subject: D-RUG today
parts:
Hi all,

D-RUG will meet at its usual time and place today: Wickson 2124, 3:10-5PM. There will be no speaker, just our usual co-work, Q&A, and cookies.

Thanks to D-RUG veteran Ryan Peek for presiding today.  Check out the notes from Ryan's previous D-RUG talks:

 - Customizing Your R Setup with .Rprofile: http://www.noamross.net/blog/2012/11/2/rprofile.html
 - Creating Web Apps with Shiny: http://www.noamross.net/blog/2014/1/28/rpeekshiny.html

Finally, sorry I've been a bit slow getting the write-up of last week's talk on vectorization up on the web.  They should be posted by the end of this week.

Best,

Noam
